parts.name: Button
parts.description: A native action button with loading and press feedback. Native button attributes and ref are forwarded; type defaults to button.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Visual treatment: solid primary, bordered secondary or text.

props.name: scaleOnPress
props.description: Allow press scaling. Set false for navigation-like actions.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner, sets aria-busy and disables activation.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size: small, medium or large.

props.name: type
props.description: Native button behavior. Defaults to button to avoid accidental form submission.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the native control.

props.name: name
props.description: Native form submission field name.

props.name: value
props.description: Value submitted when this button is used as the form submitter.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Native activation handler.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not already name the element.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.

parts.name: CloseButton
parts.description: An icon-only close action. Always renders a native type="button" control; label supplies its accessible name.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the icon-only close action.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the native control.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Native activation handler.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.
